title: Titanium Fuel Cell End Plate
function: Hydrogen fuel cell stack end pressure plate
alloyReason: Grade 2 CP-Ti (UNS R50400) is selected for Titanium Fuel Cell End Plate where formability and corrosion resistance are prioritized over absolute strength. With 40% elongation and excellent weldability, Grade 2 CP-Ti forms a stable TiO₂ passive film that provides immunity to pitting in chloride environments up to 260°C. Its 345 MPa yield strength with 30% elongation makes it ideal for Hydrogen fuel cell stack end pressure plate requiring cold forming or bending without cracking. This rationale is driven by hydrogen fuel cell stack end pressure plate and specific design requirements.
process: Closed-die forging net shape for hydrogen hardware geometry
CNC precision machining with SPC sampling
TIG welding all positions with SPC sampling
DPI dye penetrant inspect with SPC sampling
surfaceTreatment: Thermal oxidation 700C 2h in air to grow controlled 300nm TiO2 barrier layer for H2 permeation reduction — tailored for hydrogen fuel cell application
commonFailures: Thermal ratcheting under cyclic temperature - controlled by stress-relief anneal 675C 2h Ar below beta-transus — critical for hydrogen fuel cell performance

faq.q: What downhole temperature rating does Titanium Fuel Cell End Plate have?
faq.a: Grade 2 CP-Ti maintains >90% of room-temperature tensile and yield strength at 200°C and >80% at 300°C. Titanium Fuel Cell End Plate is suitable for hydrogen fuel cell in geothermal (HDR/EGS) wells up to 300°C with appropriate consideration of creep in threaded connections. Above 300°C, dedicated creep testing per ASTM E139 is recommended for design life validation.

faq.q: What is the typical lead time for Titanium Fuel Cell End Plate orders?
faq.a: Standard lead time for Titanium Fuel Cell End Plate is 15-25 business days depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders (3-5 working days) are available for prototype evaluation. Sample evaluation (1-5 units) can be expedited to 5-7 business days. Volume pricing is available for production quantities above 100 units.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Fuel Cell End Plate?
faq.a: Each Titanium Fuel Cell End Plate shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for hydrogen fuel cell.
